list.title: Datasources
list.subtitle: Target databases the broker proxies. Click a row to browse its catalog.
list.emptyHint: Add a target database, then start its proxy — registering pushes its catalog automatically.

toast.refreshNotified: {notified, plural, one {# proxy stream notified} other {# proxy streams notified}}
toast.refreshNoProxy: no proxy currently attached — nothing was notified

probe.refreshNotified: {notified, plural, =0 {no proxy attached} one {# proxy notified} other {# proxies notified}}

form.editDescription: Update the advisory connection details for this datasource.
form.addDescription: Pre-provision a datasource by name. Its proxy fills in the rest when it registers.
form.engineImmutableHint: Engine can't be changed after creation.
form.catalogAdoptionVerify: Verify — prove the catalog against this connection's backend
form.catalogAdoptionTrust: Trust — adopt the held catalog with no probe
form.catalogAdoptionHint: Verify costs one hash query per schema at connect and makes no assumption about how many backends answer. Trust skips the probe entirely, which is sound while one proxy reaches one backend under one service account.
form.advisoryHint: Connection details are advisory and optional — the proxy is authoritative and overwrites them when it registers. No credentials are stored: the control plane never connects to the target.

catalog.emptyHint: The catalog appears once this datasource's proxy connects and pushes its schema. If a proxy is already connected, Refresh nudges it to re-introspect now.
catalog.toastExported: Exported {count, plural, one {# classification} other {# classifications}}.
catalog.toastImported: Imported {count, plural, one {# classification} other {# classifications}}.
catalog.toastRefreshNotified: {notified, plural, one {# proxy stream notified} other {# proxy streams notified}}
catalog.toastRefreshNoProxy: no proxy currently attached — nothing was notified

deleteDialog.title: Delete datasource
deleteDialog.description: Delete {name} and its catalog rows? Policies scoped to it will no longer resolve. This cannot be undone.
